description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git LFS integration with Perforce depot and Git P4. It performs a series of test cases to verify that large files are correctly stored in Git LFS based on size thresholds, extensions, and compression, and manages repository setup, file addition, and removal operations.

methods.name: test_file_in_lfs
methods.description: Verifies that a file's top lines contain version, oid, size information and that the corresponding object exists in Git LFS storage, matching the expected content.

methods.name: test_file_count_in_dir
methods.description: Checks that the expected number of files are present in a directory.

search-terms: shell script for git p4 git-lfs testing
